name: [v11.1 & EVENTS] Wings of Glory 🦅
desc:
🏆 AviAwards 2024 Best Game Winner
_______________________
Take to the skies in dogfights with over 150 aircraft from early WW2 fighters to modern fighter jets! Wings of Glory is a combat aircraft simulator that puts you behind the controls of your favorite planes across a variety of scenic maps.
